delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: This permanently removes your account and all of your personal data. Workspace data you created stays with the organization.
delete.ownerBlock: Owners must transfer ownership before deleting their account.
delete.confirmBody: This action can't be undone. Type your email to confirm.

Members.title: Team members
Members.subtitle: Invite teammates and manage their access.

role.ownerHint: Full control. Billing and ownership transfer.
role.adminHint: Manage members, settings, and all data.
role.managerHint: Full access to clients, projects, tasks. Finance is read-only.
role.memberHint: Sees only assigned projects and tasks. No finance.

actions.removeConfirmBody: They'll lose access immediately. Their projects and contributions stay in the workspace.
actions.ownerOnlyAction: Only the owner can do this.

errors.ownerRemove: The owner can't be removed. Transfer ownership first.
errors.selfDemote: You can't change your own role here.
errors.promoteToAdmin: Only the owner can promote someone to Admin.

actions.revokeConfirmBody: The link for {email} will stop working. You can send a new invite anytime.
